title: Brentford FC
summary: The Mediterranean Plus at Brentford's training ground.
caption:
The Mediterranean Plus at Brentford's training ground.

Only the best for this innovative club. Our Plus size chambers have a larger diameter, and this model comes with an extra module for length - perfect for when four players want to recline. On top of the standard engineer training, we also provide extra training for teams, giving greater depth in hyperbaric theory and day-to-day use.
